$comment: SZL Holdings GitHub -> Hugging Face mirror map. Consumed by .github/workflows/hf-mirror.yml. Org casing is literal: SZLHOLDINGS.

targets.$why_replace: Empty keeps the strict additive-only rule: any staged file whose bytes differ from its Hub copy fails closed at preflight. The seven differing paths above stay preserved. Adding a path here is an owner decision; README.md is rendered and can never be listed, and a path cannot be both preserved and replaced.
targets.$why_preserve_hub_paths: Derived from Hub main 40381c985b1eaebd5007626c0c58e25838d32389 (20 files) on 2026-09-25. The first 11 entries exist only on the Hub. The last 7 also exist on GitHub with different bytes; the Hub copy is kept and never overwritten, so the mirror changes only README.md (release block) and adds new files. Reconciling those 7 is an owner decision for a separate reviewed Hub PR with an exact parent_commit.
targets.$why_no_push_lane: hub-sync propagates deletions. This Hub repo holds artifacts absent from the GitHub tree, including the Kernel Hub build and the measured receipts. The push lane has been removed from hf-mirror.yml and the plan job fails closed if any target sets mirror_on_push to anything other than false. Release-only and additive; the card is loaded from the Hub so curated front matter survives.
